questions.question: What does 'ethics by design' mean?
choices: Adding an ethics review after the product launches
Building ethical considerations into the development process from the start
Writing a mission statement about ethics
Hiring an ethics consultant at the end of the project
questions.explanation: Ethics by design means integrating ethical considerations into every phase of development — requirements, design, implementation, testing, and deployment — not treating it as an afterthought.

questions.question: Why must an ethical framework include a monitoring plan?
choices: Monitoring is required by law in all jurisdictions
AI systems drift over time as data distributions change, so fairness must be continuously checked
Monitoring looks good in compliance audits
It prevents all future ethical issues
questions.explanation: AI models degrade as real-world data changes. A model that was fair at deployment may become biased over time. Continuous monitoring catches drift before it causes harm.

questions.question: What makes an ethical framework actionable rather than theoretical?
choices: It includes specific metrics, thresholds, and escalation processes
It's endorsed by a famous ethicist
It covers every possible ethical scenario
questions.explanation: An actionable framework defines concrete metrics (e.g., demographic parity gap < 0.1), clear roles (who is accountable), and specific processes (when to escalate). Vague principles aren't enough.
